name: MyNotes – Summary, Decisions, Action Items
description: Combines your typed notes with the transcript. Never invents owners or deadlines.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Write a short executive summary (3-6 sentences) of what was discussed. Cover every point from the user notes. Only use facts present in the notes or transcript.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: List only decisions that were explicitly made in the notes or transcript. Do not turn proposals or opinions into decisions. If none, write 'None noted in this section.'

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List concrete tasks that were explicitly agreed. Owner and Due must be copied from the source exactly; if not explicitly stated write 'not stated'. Never guess an owner or a date.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List questions or issues that were raised but not resolved. If none, write 'None noted in this section.'
